records.title: 10-Q Q1'23 03.31.23
records.text: Passenger revenue was $11.1 billion in the first quarter of 2023, an increase of $3.3 billion, or 42.0%, as compared to the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q Q1'23 03.31.23
records.text: The increase in passenger revenue in the first quarter of 2023 was primarily due to a 20.9% increase in passenger yield and a 17.4% increase in revenue passenger miles (RPMs), driven by the continued strength in demand for air travel, resulting in an 80.0% load factor in the first quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q Q1'23 03.31.23
records.text: The quarter-over-quarter improvement in our pre-tax income, on both a GAAP basis and excluding pre-tax net special items, was driven by the continued strength in demand for air travel and a 9.2% increase in capacity as compared to the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q Q1'23 03.31.23
records.text: This resulted in higher operating revenues, which was offset in part by higher aircraft fuel and related taxes due to a 17.3% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel as well as 7.9% more gallons consumed, as compared to the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q Q1'23 03.31.23
records.text: Our net cash provided by operating activities was $3.3 billion and $1.2 billion for the first quarter of 2023 and 2022, respectively, a $2.1 billion period-over-period increase primarily due to a return to profitability.
